Use of the app

Use encryptfs only for files you have permission to use. Follow the laws that apply to you. If you use a cloud importer, follow the provider’s terms.

Your files and passwords

Keep separate backups of important files. Check that you can open an encrypted file before you remove the original. Keep your password separate from the encrypted file. Encryptfs cannot recover lost passwords.

Check that your browser saved each file you want to keep. Files in the workspace can be lost when you clear, reload, or close the tab.
